issuer: the Texas Department of Public Safety (DPS)
note: The DPS fee page (read 2026-10-30; fees include a $1 administrative fee not charged by mail) gives a new licence for ages 18 to 84 at $33, expiring after eight years, and a licence issued under 18 at $16, expiring on the 18th birthday (the provisional licence), so a full licence is kept from 18. An ID card, 59 and younger, is $16 and expires after six years. The page states no youngest age for an ID card, so the card has none. Not held: limited-term licences for temporary visitors. On 2026-10-30 the licence was rewritten with the terms set by the holder's age, from the same page: 8 years at $33 from 18 to 84 and 2 years at $9 from 85; until then it held the 8-year licence only. Later on 2026-10-30 the card was rewritten with the terms set by the holder's age, from the same page: 6 years at $16 at 59 and younger, held as under 60, and 6 years at $6 from 60; until then it held the $16 card for any age.

sources.title: Texas DPS, Driver License Fees
sources.said: Under 18: new $16 Expires on your 18th birthday ... Age 18 to 84: new $33 Expires after eight years (on your birthday) ... Age 59 and younger: new $16 Expires after six years (on your birthday) ... Age 85 and older: new $9 Expires after two years (on your birthday) ... Age 60 and older: new or renewal $6 Expires after six years (on your birthday)
